topic: Facility ID data structure and population
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the correct format for storing connected facility IDs. Initially, there was confusion regarding whether to use `facility_id` (strings/UUIDs) or `facility_num`. It was decided that using UUIDs is technically superior for data integrity and relationship mapping, though an integer alias might be considered for optimization in ad-hoc queries.

Regarding the structure, it was clarified that a facility should only have one connected ID, not an array of them. The current implementation appears to involve simply inserting IDs into the field.
decisions: Connected facilities should use `facility_id` (strings/UUIDs) rather than `facility_num`.
A single facility record should only contain one connected ID, not an array of IDs.
action_items: [p1] to review the data populated by Настя for locations without sensors, specifically for CC and JCD.
